author: Marcus R. Brown
description:
`llms.txt` restates the pinned pnpm version, which means it goes stale on every Renovate bump.

This is the third time it has drifted:

- Original value: `pnpm@10.33.4`
- #1816 corrected it to `pnpm@11.17.0`
- Repo is already on `pnpm@11.25.0`

Each fix restores accuracy and resets the clock. Issue #1800 has been reopened by the same drift twice now.

## Change

```diff
-- Package manager: **pnpm** (root `packageManager: pnpm@11.17.0`)
+- Package manager: **pnpm** — exact version pinned by `packageManager` in the root `package.json`
```

Point at the source of truth instead of copying the value out of it. Nothing left to drift.

## Why not just bump it

Bumping restores the value but guarantees a fourth occurrence. The autoheal report has flagged this line repeatedly; the recurring cost is the report noise and the review cycle, not the wrong digit.

## Why the Node line is untouched

```
- Node: pinned via `.node-version` (24.x) — repo `engines` floor is `>=22.13.1`
```

Different risk profile. It references `.node-version` loosely as `24.x` rather than pinning an exact patch, and quotes the `engines` floor verbatim — both currently accurate (`.node-version` is `24.20.0`, `engines.node` is `>=22.13.1`). It degrades gracefully across patch bumps instead of going stale on each one, so there is nothing to fix.

## Verification

- Only remaining version-like string in `llms.txt` is the Node line above, confirmed accurate against `.node-version` and `package.json`
- No other file references the removed value

Closes #1800
title: docs(llms): stop duplicating the pinned pnpm version
